notes.title: V0.9.14 - Jackal - The 100th supported game
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=s1qOrk7S--I;full][/previewyoutube]

- The special Jackal profile is not created to be a fresh alternative to the original. 
It has been created to be the real competitor. It brings together all the best of previous profiles. 
Hope you guys enjoy it.
- The default Control Method is switched from Gaze to Laser
- Remove Oculus Runtime support as it caused input issue while working with Virtual Desktop.  
- Fix Punch Out profile regression bug: gesture input doesn't work

- Important info: After 5 years of early access with 100 built-in profiles, the price of 3dSenVR will be increased in the coming week and a V1.0 release will hopefully come in the early summer.

notes.title: v0.9.3 release
notes.content:
- Functionality: new camera control algorithm which will make sure that the game world is always at the view center no matter how players manipulate the camera. Much better viewing experience especially for top down games.

- Profile:
 + New profiles: Felix the Cat, Gradius, Burger Time
 + Improvement: new 3D Battle Scene for Final Fantasy
 + Fix bugs: 
  * Zelda 2: Fix bugs for Zelda 2 randomizer versions of game
  * Simon Quest: wrong layer of church curtains 
  * DrMario: scores weren't displayed in 2 player modes
  * Dragon Warrior I: dialog is invisible in default camera position
  * Final Fantasy : some minor bugs

- Last but not least currently many games profile are being dead blocked because I can not play through the game. If you can and want to offer this kind of help, please contact me, the best way is via Discord server at https://discord.gg/2ZP6mRq

tags.feature: - Functionality: new camera control algorithm which will make sure that the game world is always at the view center no matter how players manipulate the camera. Much better viewing experience especially for top down games.
+ New profiles: Felix the Cat, Gradius, Burger Time
+ Improvement: new 3D Battle Scene for Final Fantasy

notes.title: 3dSenVR gets V0.4 Update and 25% Discount
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33802247/3c3bf4c73df3e9a4c35db63a83ada5ca745aa4a7.jpg[/img]I'm very proud and excited to announce 3dSenVR V0.4 Update. 
This update includes six new profiles:
- Super Mario Bros. 3
- TwinBee
- Shatterhand
- Pinball
- Flappy Bird: motion gesture support
- Flappy Bird: first person view, motion gesture support. 

SMB3 is truly the biggest and most beautiful profile that have ever been created. I just couldn't wait to know your experience playing it.

Finally to celebrate this update, 3dSenVR will offer a 25% discount from now until 14 Sep. 
Let's grab the discount and have some nostalgic but also fresh-new fun!

notes.title: 3dSenVR has come back to Steam.
notes.content:
I'm very happy to inform you that: after six months of review, 3dSenVR has been manually approved by Steam Review Team and ready to release.
Coming with it is the Demo version that has been updated with the latest build and features:

- Improved UI
- Zero Input Lag
- Light gun support (Wild Gunman)

You all are welcome to give it a try and any feedback is much appreciated!

tags.feature: - Improved UI
- Zero Input Lag
- Light gun support (Wild Gunman)
